jupyterhub-base.name: CCPBioSim Base Image
jupyterhub-base.shortdesc: CCPBioSim JupyterHub base container for use in other training workshops.

structure-validation-uglymol.name: Uglymol Image
structure-validation-uglymol.shortdesc: Uglymol container for hosted deployment as part of the structure validation workshop.

structure-validation-workshop.name: An Introduction to Structure Validation
structure-validation-workshop.shortdesc: This course will introduce methods to deduce that starting structures for preparing simulations represent high quality starting points.

basic-statistics-workshop.name: Introducing Basic Statistics
basic-statistics-workshop.shortdesc: This course illustrates how basic statistical concepts can be applied to the analysis of biomolecular simlation data

aiida-lysozyme-workshop.name: aiida-gromacs - Lysozyme MD simulation tutorial
aiida-lysozyme-workshop.shortdesc: Data provenance tools demonstrated with Justin Lemkul's lysozyme in water simulation tutorial.

basic-analysis-workshop.name: Introducing Basic Analysis
basic-analysis-workshop.shortdesc: In this course we will explore some of the issues in simulation preparation and analysis that can trip up the unwary, and how to avoid them.

equilibration-workshop.name: An Introduction to Equilibration
equilibration-workshop.shortdesc: This course looks at one of the most common methods for assessing equilibration: the calculation of RMSDs. It may be a common approach, but is it a good one? Maybe not.

ubiquitin-analysis-workshop.name: Introduction to Analysis of Ubiquitin
ubiquitin-analysis-workshop.shortdesc: This course illustrates the application of a number of Python-based tools to the analysis of the results from a short (1 nanosecond) simulation of ubiquitin, investigating the question, how similar is the MD trajectory to the crystal and NMR structures?

clustering-workshop.name: An Introduction to Clustering
clustering-workshop.shortdesc: This course illustrates the application of a variety of clustering methods to an MD trajectory, comparing their performance.

aiida-gpcr-workshop.name: aiida-gromacs - GPCR MD simulation tutorial
aiida-gpcr-workshop.shortdesc: An advanced demonstration showing advanced GPCR workflow with full data provenance collection.

pca-workshop.name: An Introduction to Principle Component Analysis
pca-workshop.shortdesc: The aim of this course is to illustrate methods we can use to assess convergence and sampling in MD trajectories.

python-workshop.name: An Introduction to Python Programming
python-workshop.shortdesc: This course will introduce more intermediate features of Python that are useful for biomolecular modellers.

pdb2pqr-workshop.name: An Introduction to PDB2PQR
pdb2pqr-workshop.shortdesc: This short course illustrates the application of pdb2pqr to the analysis of the tautomeric and ionization states of residues in the structure of the cysteine protease cruzein (PDB code 2oz2) - the results may not be what you would have expected!

docking-workflow.name: Introducing Docking Workflows
docking-workflow.shortdesc: This course introduces docking tools and workflows.

qmmm-workshop.name: Introducing QM/MM
qmmm-workshop.shortdesc: The course will introduce non-specialists to the use of combined quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) methods for modelling enzyme-catalysed reaction mechanisms.

mm-gbsa-workshop.name: Analysing with MM-GBSA
mm-gbsa-workshop.shortdesc: This course walks through the process of perfprming a basic MM-GBSA analysis of a molecular dynamics simulation of a protein-ligand complex to estimate the ligand binding free energy.

protein-ml-workshop.name: Protein Analysis with Machine Learning
protein-ml-workshop.shortdesc: This course introduces the application of Machine Learning methods (specifically, PCA and clustering) to the analysis of protein simulation data.

protein-analysis-workshop.name: Introduction to the Analysis of Proteins
protein-analysis-workshop.shortdesc: This course introduces the application of MDTraj to the analysis of protein simulation data.

protein-preparation-workshop.name: Preparing Proteins for Simulation
protein-preparation-workshop.shortdesc: This course walks through the process of preparing a simple protein system for molecular dynamics simulation using Ambertools.

dna-workshop.name: Running DNA Simulations
dna-workshop.shortdesc: This course introduces tools for running simulations on DNA systems.

protein-simulation-workshop.name: Running MD Simulations
protein-simulation-workshop.shortdesc: This workshop demonstrates two approaches to running MD simulations on a simple protein system.

coarse-graining-workshop.name: Introducing Coarse-Graining
coarse-graining-workshop.shortdesc: This workshop introduces tools for setup and running coarse-grain simulations.

openff-workshop.name: Introducing OpenForceField Tools
openff-workshop.shortdesc: This workshop introduces the openforcefield tooling.
